Stark Industries Mobility Policy v4.0
Effective 2026-05-01

Eligibility: Permanent and Long-Term assignments, bands B2 through B4.

Benefit Schedule

Benefit | Cap | Duration
Temporary housing | USD 5000 / month | 60 days
Rental deposit | 2 months rent | one-time
Shipment of household goods | 40 cubic feet | one-time
Tax assistance | full coverage | duration of assignment
Settling-in allowance | EUR 3500 | one-time
Travel to host location | round-trip economy | one-time per assignment

Notes
Spousal job-search support is available on request.

Home sale assistance up to USD 8000 for the employee's primary residence sale costs.

Scouting trip: one pre-assignment visit, up to 5 days, economy class.
